Available commands:
/agents       List or inspect agent and teammate tasks
/autopilot    Manage repo autopilot intake and context
/branch       Show git branch information
/bridge       Inspect bridge helpers and spawn bridge sessions
/clear        Clear conversation history
/commit       Show status or create a git commit
/compact      Compact older conversation history
/config       Show or update configuration
/context      Show the active runtime system prompt
/continue     Continue the previous tool loop if it was interrupted
/copy         Copy the latest response or provided text
/cost         Show token usage and estimated cost
/diff         Show git diff output
/doctor       Show environment diagnostics
/dream        Consolidate memory
/effort       Show or update reasoning effort
/exit         Exit QuestorHarness
/export       Export the current transcript
/fast         Show or update fast mode
/feedback     Save CLI feedback to the local feedback log
/files        List files in the current workspace
/help         Show available commands
/hooks        Show configured hooks
/init         Initialize project QuestorHarness files
/issue        Show or update project issue context
/keybindings  Show resolved keybindings
/login        Show auth status or store an API key
/logout       Clear the stored API key
/mcp          Show MCP status
/memory       Inspect and manage project memory
/model        Show, switch, or manage profile models
/onboarding   Show the quickstart guide
/output-style Show or update output style
/passes       Show or update reasoning pass count
/permissions  Show or update permission mode; Tab in the TUI opens the mode picker
/plan         Toggle plan permission mode; /permissions default|full_auto exits plan explicitly
/plugin       Manage plugins
/pr_comments  Show or update project PR comments context
/privacy-settings Show local privacy and storage settings
/provider     Show or switch provider profiles
/rate-limit-options Show ways to reduce provider rate pressure
/release-notes Show recent QuestorHarness release notes
/reload-plugins Reload plugin discovery for this workspace
/resume       Restore the latest saved session
/rewind       Remove the latest conversation turn(s)
/session      Inspect the current session storage
/share        Create a shareable transcript snapshot
/ship         Queue and execute an questor-driven repo task
/skills       List or show available skills
/stats        Show session statistics
/status       Show session status
/stop         Interrupt the running turn from TUI/questor channels
/subagents    Show subagent usage and inspect worker tasks
/summary      Summarize conversation history
/tag          Create a named snapshot of the current session
/tasks        Manage background tasks
/theme        List, set, show or preview TUI themes
/turns        Show or update maximum agentic turn count
/upgrade      Show upgrade instructions
/usage        Show usage and token estimates
/version      Show the installed QuestorHarness version
/voice        Show or update voice mode
